name: TripoSR Image Preprocessing
aliases: Sim2Real on Real Car Images Preprocessing
definition: Image preprocessing pipeline that removes background, resizes foreground, and converts to a 50% gray background format required by the TripoSR model.
summary: TripoSR Image Preprocessing prepares single-view images for 3D reconstruction by removing backgrounds, centering subjects, and compositing them over a fixed 50% gray background to normalize scale and improve accuracy.
